description: T1K-01AC is the drawing identifier for auxiliary power-supply component in AutomationDirect's Terminator Field I/O collection. An auxiliary power supply provides the electrical form required by its selected loads. Its physical drawing is used for mounting and access while its electrical specification establishes input, output and protection requirements.

For example, in a control panel supplying its controller and interface equipment, use the T1K-01AC reference to coordinate input and output conductor approach, mounting and cooling access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Terminator Field IO/T1K-01AC.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep input and output conductor approach, mounting and cooling access visible in the layout.
